author: Huawei
description:
At #HiFS2026, #Huawei unveiled new solutions and initiatives to help financial institutions move beyond digital and advance toward #AgenticBanking.

Bringing together 800+ representatives from financial institutions across 60+ countries and regions, along with 70+ industry partners, the summit spotlighted how open-source models, hybrid AI architecture, and data-AI convergence can accelerate large-scale financial AI adoption.

From Financial Data Intelligence Solution 6.0 to Digital CORE Solution 6.0, Huawei is working with customers and partners to build resilient infrastructure, modernize applications, enhance data-driven decision-making, and enable Agentic AI transformation.

Learn more: https://bit.ly/4v7i6lP #FintelligentWorld #HuaweiNews
title: HiFS 2026 Advances the Era of Agentic Banking
